question: Can even immense material wealth equal the value of the Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents vast wealth
The teaching's value is being compared
inference: Even one who could amass an ocean filled with jewels cannot equal the value of this teaching.
uncertainties: akretuṃ is an unusual infinitive form; interpreted as 'to buy' or 'to acquire'
plain_english: Even if one had the wealth to acquire an ocean filled with jewels.
